fish-narc.evidence: mirrors api/v1/scene-figures.json (archive research pass 2026-10-11, build_circle.py) plus the wave-27 Uncle-LP diligence below. Facts reproduced here so the producer page is self-contained; the canonical copy lives in scene-figures.json.
facts: Two as-credited archive productions: 'Soul Shaking' (2018-01-03) and 'Pavement' (2019-12-30), both (prod. Fish Narc).
Musical moniker of Ben Funkhouser; Seattle/Olympia, Washington; member of Thraxxhouse and GothBoiClique (archive scene-figures research pass).

Produced Lil Peep's 'Goth Angel Sinner' LP; worked with Wicca Phase Springs Eternal, Lil Tracy, Horse Head, and Cold Hart; production noted for live guitar instead of samples (archive scene-figures research pass).
Solo LPs: 'WiLDFiRE' (2020), 'Camouflage' (2022), 'fruiting body' [KLP295] (2023), 'frog song' (2025, K Records) (archive scene-figures research pass).

Fifth solo LP 'Uncle' announced (Stereogum, August 2026): 11 tracks on K Records [KLP313], produced by Asheville's Alex Farrar (Wednesday, MJ Lenderman, Fiddlehead). Singles 'Much Less Me' and 'Big Dumb World'.

Wave-27 diligence 2026-10-11: 'Uncle' is STILL PRE-RELEASE. Upcomingvinyl and Faygoluvers carry 2026-10-16; AltPress's October calendar lists fish narc - Uncle (K) on Oct 16; yourcountdown.to (crawled 2026-10-11) counts down to 2026-10-16. ginseng.evidence: verified: Underground Underdogs interviews (2019-01-28 text interview; 2020-02-23 first video interview).
facts: One as-credited archive production: 'master key' ft. Lil Wintr x Marcelo (prod. ginseng).
Described by Underground Underdogs as a multi-faceted producer with several musical projects (interview 2019-01-28).
Part of the D1 circle alongside Hella Sketchy, Shiro, Marcelo, and Despair, per the same interview; the archive's 'master key' pairs two D1 figures (Lil Wintr x Marcelo) over his production.
Runs the vocal project Lil Wintr, which the interview traces from a joke project to a serious ongoing outlet.

Raps as Lil Wintr under his birth name Christian Baello; from Lake Elsinore, California; also the guitarist/percussionist in the indie band dream, ivory with his brother Louie Baello (Peso Talk) (The FADER, 2019-06-04).
First video interview (Underground Underdogs, 2020-02-23) covers his musical projects, memories with Hella Sketchy, and how he gets beat placements.
